fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-09-09 around 19:25 hrs, it was reported that a wallet containing about Rs. 6,000 and identity cards was picked from the complainant near Nila Nagar Bus Stand Area in Chennai. Harini Selvam reported the matter orally at Chennai North PS; the contact number given was 9000000475. A person named Sanjay Anand, associated with the number 9000000477, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complaint refers to another person whose identity could not be established. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and photographs. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00472, as the mobile number 9000000477 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Reported theft occurred while the victim was boarding a bus.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, CCTV, bus stand, photograph, mobile number, evening, suspect
